questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual modal de transporte predomina no transporte de cargas no Brasil?
questions.hint: Pense no que mais se vê levando mercadorias pelas estradas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama o modal de transporte feito por trens sobre trilhos?
questions.hint: A palavra vem de "ferro" e "via".

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que é uma hidrovia?
options: Uma rota de navegação em rios e lagos
Um cano que leva água às cidades
Uma estrada à beira de um rio
questions.answer: Uma rota de navegação em rios e lagos

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Oleodutos e gasodutos fazem parte de qual modal?
questions.hint: Observe a segunda parte das palavras do enunciado.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual modal costuma ser o mais rápido em longas distâncias?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama a área que planeja o transporte, o armazenamento e a entrega de mercadorias?
questions.hint: Essa área busca fazer o produto chegar na hora certa com o menor custo.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é um exemplo de rede de comunicação?
questions.hint: Ela transporta informações, não mercadorias.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é a principal vantagem do transporte rodoviário?
options: Transportar os maiores volumes de uma só vez
Ter o menor custo em longas distâncias
Levar a carga de porta a porta
questions.answer: Levar a carga de porta a porta

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Uma mineradora precisa levar milhões de toneladas de minério por centenas de quilômetros em terra. Qual modal é o mais adequado?
questions.hint: Pense em grande volume, longa distância e custo baixo por tonelada.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em comparação com o trem, qual é uma desvantagem do caminhão em longas distâncias?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em qual região do Brasil o transporte de pessoas por rios é mais importante no dia a dia?
questions.hint: Pense na região de grandes rios e com poucas estradas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quando uma carga vai de caminhão até a ferrovia e depois segue de navio, como se chama esse transporte?
questions.hint: Mais de um modal é usado no mesmo trajeto.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Para que servem os cabos submarinos de fibra óptica?
options: Para levar petróleo entre os portos
Para ligar países e continentes à internet
Para guiar os navios à noite
questions.answer: Para ligar países e continentes à internet

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique por que o transporte de cargas no Brasil passou a depender tanto das rodovias a partir de meados do século XX.
questions.hint: Pense nas escolhas de investimento e na chegada da indústria de automóveis.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Dê um problema causado pela predominância rodoviária no Brasil e explique como ele afeta o preço dos produtos.
questions.hint: Considere o combustível, o estado das estradas e as longas distâncias.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Escolha uma região do Brasil e sugira um modal que deveria receber mais investimento. Justifique em 2 ou 3 frases.
questions.hint: Considere o relevo, os rios e o tipo de carga da região.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What base is the hexadecimal number system?

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: How many different digits and letters does hexadecimal use in total?
questions.hint: Count 0 to 9, then A to F.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the denary value of the hex digit A?
questions.hint: It comes straight after 9.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the denary value of the hex digit F?
questions.hint: It is the largest single hex digit.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the name for a group of 4 bits?
questions.hint: It sounds like a small bite.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert the binary nibble 1011 to a single hex digit.
questions.hint: Work out the denary value first using 8, 4, 2, 1.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert hex 1A to denary.
questions.hint: The left digit is worth 16 times its value.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert hex 2F to denary.
questions.hint: Work out 2 × 16, then add the value of F.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert hex A5 to denary.
questions.hint: A is 10, so start with 10 × 16.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert denary 30 to hexadecimal.
questions.hint: Divide by 16 and write the remainder as a hex digit.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert denary 200 to hexadecimal.
questions.hint: How many 16s fit into 200, and what is left?

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert hex 3C to 8-bit binary.
questions.hint: Turn each hex digit into its own 4 bits.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the largest denary value that two hex digits can represent?
questions.hint: Think about hex FF.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: A web colour code is written with three pairs of hex digits for red, green and blue. Which colour does the code FF0000 show?
questions.hint: Only the first pair is at its maximum.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Explain why programmers often use hexadecimal instead of long binary numbers. Give two reasons.
questions.hint: Think about length and the chance of copying mistakes.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert the binary number 1010110 to hexadecimal.
questions.hint: Group the bits into fours starting from the right.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is a monologue?
options: A long speech by one character
A song sung by a group
A list of the actors in a play
questions.answer: A long speech by one character

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word describes how a performer speaks a line, including pace and clarity?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: A monologue is usually written in which person: first, second or third?
questions.hint: Think about which pronoun a character uses to talk about themselves.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What word names the attitude or feeling expressed by a speaker's voice?
questions.hint: It can be sarcastic, gentle or angry.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What do we call a short silence used on purpose during a speech?
questions.hint: It can create tension before an important line.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What does "pace" mean in spoken performance?
options: How high or low the voice is
How fast or slowly someone speaks
questions.answer: How fast or slowly someone speaks

questions.subject: en
questions.q: How is a dramatic monologue different from a dialogue?
options: It has no character in it
One character does the speaking, often to a silent listener
questions.answer: One character does the speaking, often to a silent listener

questions.subject: en
questions.q: A character says: "So that's it, then. You're leaving." Which delivery best shows quiet heartbreak?
options: Slow, soft, with a pause after "then"
questions.answer: Slow, soft, with a pause after "then"

questions.subject: en
questions.q: A character says: "Oh, wonderful. Another brilliant idea from you." Which tone fits this line best?
questions.hint: Consider whether the speaker truly means the praise.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which technique would best show a character becoming more and more angry?
options: Gradually raising volume and speeding up
Reading the lines from a page
Turning away and whispering every word
questions.answer: Gradually raising volume and speeding up

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which opening would hook an audience most strongly in a monologue?
options: "My name is Tom and I am twelve."
"Today was a normal day with normal things."
"This is my speech about my week."
"I never meant to open that door. But I did."
questions.answer: "I never meant to open that door. But I did."
questions.hint: Look for the line that makes you want to know more.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In a monologue, what does a character's repetition of "It's fine. It's fine." most likely suggest?
options: The character is talking to a crowd
The character is trying to convince themselves
The character has forgotten the script
questions.answer: The character is trying to convince themselves
questions.hint: Think about what lies beneath the words.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the most useful reason to use body language during a monologue?
options: It adds meaning that supports the words
It hides the words from the audience
It replaces the need for a character
questions.answer: It adds meaning that supports the words

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write the first two sentences of a monologue spoken by a lighthouse keeper who has just seen a strange light at sea. Show their emotion through word choice.
questions.hint: Use "I" and hint at their feelings instead of naming them.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose one emotion. Explain how you would use your voice to show it in a monologue, mentioning at least two of: tone, pace, volume, pause.
questions.hint: Describe what the audience would actually hear.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Why do you think performers rehearse a monologue aloud many times, instead of only reading it silently?
questions.hint: Consider what can only be discovered by hearing the voice.
